notes: OpenAI official pricing and model documentation list Standard, Batch, Flex, and Fast rates per 1M tokens; Priority is an alias for Fast. Public V1 fields store Standard short-context prices and Batch short-context input/output prices. Prompts with 272K or fewer input tokens use short-context pricing; prompts with more than 272K input tokens use long-context pricing, with the selected tier applied to the full request. Pricing V2 represents the published short/long context prices for every processing mode.
